name: 底边嵌条
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: game-card investment indicator design candidate, production-oriented painted UI.
Input image 1 is a REFERENCE for the existing card, its frame, typography and turquoise art. This is not a battlefield redesign.
Create a polished SQUARE contact sheet showing FOUR COMPLETE copies of the blue attack card “上挑” in a tidy 2 by 2 arrangement on a flat dark desaturated navy background. Large readable cards, generous narrow gutters, straight-on view, original tall card proportions. Preserve the blue metal outer frame, silver title ribbon, energy cost 3, turquoise illustration, type “攻击”, and body “造成9点伤害3次。” on all four cards. Redesign ONLY the added investment indicators. Remove all old rectangular indicators from the source before applying this new concept. Do not include the battlefield, HUD, hand of cards, inset zooms, decorations or other UI.
Required states in reading order:
TOP LEFT: damage bonus +6 only. No hit marker and no empty hit backing.
TOP RIGHT: NO damage bonus; exactly ONE extra-hit token only. No +0 and no numeral 1.
BOTTOM LEFT: +6 damage bonus AND exactly THREE identical separate extra-hit tokens. No numerical hit count here.
BOTTOM RIGHT: NO damage bonus; a SINGLE extra-hit icon with the exact adjacent numeral 12. No twelve repeated tokens and no multiplier sign.
The visual system must feel complete when either component is absent. Single-purpose indicators occupy only their needed space. Numeric overflow is a compact single line; no wrapping or cascading into card rules. Keep the indicators readable at actual gameplay scale, modest relative to a card, with clean bold silhouettes. Keep title, energy, central type tab and rules untouched and unobstructed.
Only added text outside the cards: the variant letter in the upper left margin. No subtitles, explanations, labels, captions or marketing copy.
Variant letter: "C".
Design direction: Place all indicators along the BOTTOM EDGE of the PORTRAIT, directly ABOVE the central card-type tab without covering it. A short recessed slate-metal rail hugs the lower RIGHT portion of the illustration frame. Warm ivory +6 is engraved in one gold-trimmed recessed segment; separate small pale-blue triangular studs fill an adjoining independent segment. One stud for one extra hit; three individual studs for three. At 12, one stud plus 12. The rail contracts to the occupied segment for single-value cases, with no empty sockets. Subtle machining, low relief, smoothly integrated into the existing portrait border; no top-right overlay at all.
